title: eludite.terminal.send input
description: Type text into a terminal, as if the person typed it: it goes to the same PTY the person types into, and shows in the Terminal window in real time (the tab says "Agent <name> is typing"). With `newline` (default true) Enter follows, so a command runs. Answers the `mark` before the text: pass it to eludite.terminal.wait (`prompt: true` waits for the command to finish and answers its output and exit code) or eludite.terminal.read (`mode: since`). For agents, class execute decided by the solution policy's `terminal.run` (`prompt` by default: the first send of an agent session asks; "Allow for this session" holds). Refused after the person typed during your eludite.terminal.wait (it answered `interrupted_by: "user"`) until you call eludite.terminal.read: look at what the person did first. Control characters work as text: `\u0003` is Ctrl+C (interrupt), `\u0004` Ctrl+D (end of input).

terminal.description: The terminal: its id from eludite.terminal.open or eludite.terminal.list (`term1`, `term2`, ...). Default: the active terminal of the Terminal window (the one last opened or selected).

text.description: What to type. With `newline`, do not end it with a newline yourself.

newline.description: Press Enter after the text (default true). False types the text only (an answer to a prompt that reads single keys, or control characters).
